scope: Direct finite Jacobians at r=1,d=3..6 and (r,d)=(2,5),(2,6),(3,7) for each functional. Projected finite Jacobians at (r,d)=(3,7),(3,8),(4,9), with 44,51,66 moments, including exact subleading sphere normalizations. General-degree nonvanishing, all-order purity and global surjectivity are written proofs, not finite-check conclusions.
